story: I worked 7 years as a teacher at a private school in Dehradun and retired on 30 September 2026. The school has not paid my gratuity of Rs 2,10,000. What can I do?

timeline.event: Retired from private school in Dehradun

timeline.user_words: The school has not paid my gratuity of Rs 2,10,000

rules.name: wage_due_date
rules.message: After your last day (30 Sep 2026), the law says final wages must be paid within two working days - about 03 Oct 2026 (not counting Sundays and national holidays; your State can set a different limit).
rules.label: When final pay was due

rules.name: wage_claim_limitation
rules.message: File your wage claim before 03 Oct 2029 (1060 days left). This counts 3 years from 03 Oct 2026 (when final wages wages fell due; each later month has its own, later deadline). Don't wait for the last date.
rules.label: Last date to file your wage claim

rules.name: where_to_claim
rules.message: You (or your union) can file a claim before the wage authority. For banks, railways, telecom, mines, insurance and central PSUs this is the Central Government's authority; for other employers it is your State labour department. It can order up to ten times the claim as compensation and recovers unpaid amounts like land revenue. The employer has to prove they paid you.
rules.label: Where to claim

answer.summary: You are a teacher who retired on 30 September 2026. Your private school in Dehradun has not paid your gratuity of Rs 2,10,000. The school must pay your final wages and gratuity. You can file a claim with the labour authority to recover your money.

claims.text: Your gratuity and final wages are protected under the Code on Wages, 2019.
The school must pay your final wages within two working days of your retirement.
You have three years from when the wages were due to file a claim.
The school has to prove they paid you the money.
You can file a claim for up to ten times your claim as extra compensation.

next_steps.action: Contact the District Legal Services Authority in Dehradun at 15100 for free legal help.
next_steps.why: You may qualify for free legal aid, and they can guide you on how to file your claim.

next_steps.action: File a wage claim with the Labour Department before the three-year deadline.
next_steps.why: This is the official way to recover your unpaid gratuity and wages.

support.text: Your gratuity and final wages are protected under the Code on Wages, 2019.

draft_notes:
How to send it:
1. Find their correct address in your offer letter, salary slip, or the company's registered office on the MCA website (mca.gov.in).
2. Fill every [FILL] slot. Remove anything that isn't true - only state facts you can prove.
3. Send by Speed Post and keep the receipt and the tracking proof of delivery. Also send a copy by email or WhatsApp and keep a screenshot.
4. Wait 15 days. Sending this letter does NOT stop any legal time limit - file your claim/complaint before the deadline shown, even if they haven't replied.
5. Free help to check the letter: legal aid 15100 or Tele-Law 14454.

Laws this letter relies on: Code on Wages, 2019, s.17(1)-(4) (Time limit for payment of wages); Code on Wages, 2019, s.45(1)-(6) (Claims authority, compensation, recovery and time limit); Code on Wages, 2019, s.59 (Burden of proof on employer); Code on Wages, 2019, s.2(d) (Central or State Government: whose authority applies)
